meta.title: Canadian investing provider register (brokers, robo-advisors, crypto platforms, tax software)
meta.method: Values come only from provider pages or regulator pages (CIPF member list, CIRO dealer directory, CSA authorized crypto platform list, CRA NETFILE certified-software list) opened with WebFetch on 2026-10-22. 'unknown' means not confirmed on a page actually opened.

ciro_dealers.page_last_updated: October 13, 2026 (per metadata); full directory not paginated by fetch

commission_canadian_stocks_etfs.value: $0 commission on listed Canadian stocks and ETFs.

commission_us_stocks_etfs.value: $0 commission. Pass-through exchange, ECN, TAF or ORF fees may apply to some US-listed orders and appear on trade confirmations.

options_commission.value: No base fee. Equity and ETF options: US$0 per contract on Core, Premium and Generation. Index options per contract: SPX/SPXW US$1, VIX US$1, NDX US$1, RUT/RUTW US$0.50, XSP US$0.25, DJX US$0.25. Early exercise or do-not-exercise instruction US$45; auto-exercise and assignment $0.

currency_conversion.value: US-listed trades in a CAD account: 1.5% on top of the WSII Corporate Exchange Rate, on every plan tier. Conversions inside a USD account: 1.5% under $10,000; 1.0% from $10,000 to $24,999.99; 0.5% from $25,000 to $99,999.99; 0% at $100,000 and above (per transaction).

usd_registered_accounts.value: Yes. A USD account can be added to TFSA, FHSA, RRSP, spousal RRSP, LIRA, RESP, non-registered, margin, corporate and crypto accounts. Not available for RRIF, spousal RRIF or LIF. Cost: $10 + tax per month after a 30-day free trial on Core; free for Premium ($100,000+) and Generation ($500,000+).

account_types.value: TFSA, RRSP, spousal RRSP, FHSA, RESP (family plan and individual plan for yourself; an individual plan for someone else is 'coming soon'; self-directed RESP transfers are in beta), RRIF, LIRA, LIF and pension transfers in, non-registered, margin, joint non-registered, corporate, crypto. Spousal RRIF is currently unavailable.

admin_inactivity_fees.value: $0 to open, close or keep an inactive account. The only recurring fee is the Core-tier USD account fee ($10/month).

transfer_out_fee.value: $0 for outgoing transfers to another institution.

transfer_in_rebate.value: Automatically reimburses the transfer-out fee charged by the other institution on transfers of $25,000 or more. No cap is stated; the page cites typical fees of $50 to $150.

minimum_to_open.value: No account minimum stated. The Core tier starts at $1 in assets.

fractional_shares.value: Yes. Thousands of Canadian and US stocks and ETFs, from $1, traded in real time during market hours.

drip.value: Yes. Dividend reinvestment is switched on or off for a whole trading account, not per security. No reinvestment fee is listed; the FX fee applies when USD dividends are reinvested in a non-USD account.

cash_interest.value: Chequing account: Core 1.25%, Premium 1.75%, Generation 2.25%. Interest on cash held in self-directed trading accounts: unknown (not stated).

ciro_member.value: Yes. The site footer shows 'CIRO Member', and CIRO's Dealers We Regulate page lists Wealthsimple Investments Inc.

cipf_member.value: Yes. 'Wealthsimple Investments Inc.' is on CIPF's current member list. Crypto holdings are not CIPF-protected.

platforms_apps.value: Wealthsimple app (mobile) and the web app at app.wealthsimple.com (the page is titled 'Wealthsimple Trade').

current_signup_offer.value: 1% Match: a cash bonus of 1% of net qualifying transfers of $25,000 or more, initiated within 30 days of registering. Funding cap $2,000,000 (maximum bonus $20,000), paid in 24 monthly instalments, with a 730-day hold. Effective May 4, 2026, with no fixed end date. A $25 refer-a-friend reward is also listed.

commission_canadian_stocks_etfs.value: $0 to buy or sell Canadian-listed stocks and ETFs online. No ECN fees on Canadian securities.

commission_us_stocks_etfs.value: $0 commission. ECN fees apply only to direct-routed orders (for example US$0.003 to US$0.004 per share removing liquidity); overnight-session fills US$0.003 per share; SEC fee on US sales of 0.0000206 x trade value.

options_commission.value: US equity options: $0 base and $0 per contract (Questrade Plus subscribers get CA$0.05/contract cashback). Canadian options: $0 + CA$0.99 per contract. US index options: $0 + US$0.99 per contract from September 28, 2026 (volume tiers before that). Exercise $24.95; assignment free; $45 service fee if Questrade liquidates an option on expiry day.

usd_registered_accounts.value: Yes. USD can be held directly in registered accounts ('Dual-currency enabled for free'; no forced conversions on US stocks and ETFs). No separate USD registered account fee is listed.

account_types.value: RRSP, spousal RRSP, LIRA, locked-in RRSP, RRIF, LIF, RESP, family RESP, TFSA, FHSA, individual cash, individual margin, joint margin, corporate cash and margin, partnership, sole proprietorship, individual and joint informal trust, formal trust, estate, and Forex & CFD accounts.

admin_inactivity_fees.value: No annual account fees. Inactivity fee: free both over and under $1,000 combined equity. Questrade Plus (optional) costs $19.99/month.

transfer_out_fee.value: $150 for a full or partial transfer to another institution.

transfer_in_rebate.value: Rebates the fee charged by the other institution, up to $150 per account, applied automatically to eligible transfers.

minimum_to_open.value: unknown (the 'How much do I need to start investing?' FAQ answer did not load)

drip.value: Yes. 'Almost every stock or ETF' is eligible; free with no transaction fees; reinvests fractionally when fractional shares are enabled.

cash_interest.value: Effectively 0%. The published formula is CAD prime - 8.50% and USD prime - 10.00%, and with Questrade's CAD prime of 4.45% and USD prime of 7.00% every tier is negative. The page states a negative result means 0% interest.

margin_rates.value: Non-registered CAD: prime + 4.25% under $100,000, prime + 3.25% at $100,000+. Non-registered USD: prime + 4.50% and + 3.50%. Registered debit balances: CAD prime + 8.10%, USD prime + 8.35%. Questrade CAD prime is 4.45% (as of Oct 30, 2025) and USD prime 7.00% (as of Sep 17, 2026), which works out to about 8.70% / 7.70% CAD and 11.50% / 10.50% USD (our arithmetic).

platforms_apps.value: Questrade Pro (active trading platform) is named on the trading-platforms page. Other app names (Questrade Edge, mobile app) were not confirmed on pages fetched.
